messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

The relation 'more likely to have' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject population is at a higher risk of having the medical condition or issue specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'risk factors include': The subject condition or event has risk factors that include the object entity.
C. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'occurs in': The medical condition specified by the subject entity is associated with or found in the group of individuals described by the object entity.
